styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small blue pay machine with a screen panel and a few buttons. Its dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral, so the outline is a uniform near-black line around the whole shape. That is the sticker look. The references with comparable props (stall, well, hedge) use tinted dark-material outlines at 0-33% neutral. The body ramp is shallow, about 3 steps (light blue, mid blue, dark) plus the screen and button accents. It has 9 visible tones per tile, equal to the hedge but well below the stall (17) and well (20). It has no flat fills (0% near-flat coverage), but the surfaces carry little grain or texture beyond the panel details. A careful artist would not accept it next to the stall and well, because the outline and shading are flatter and more sticker-like.
